title: iceberg.table.write.completed
description: A CloudEvents 1.0 event, structured-mode JSON, that an Iceberg writer emits once when it has finished with a table for a run. Generated from zamboni.events; do not edit by hand. See docs/write-completed.md.

id.description: Deterministic, so a redelivered or re-emitted event can be recognised: "<warehouse>/<namespace levels joined by />/<table>@<snapshot_id>".

dataschema.description: https://github.com/paulcaron16k/Zamboni/blob/main/docs/write-completed.md/<major>.<minor> -- the contract version the event was written against.

warehouse.description: The warehouse's name, as the catalog knows it. The matching key: a consumer maps the event to a table by this name, exactly.

namespace.description: The namespace as a list of levels, outermost first -- never a dotted string, because a dot inside a level is legal and "a.b" is ambiguous.

table.description: The table's name within the namespace.

snapshot_id.description: The last snapshot this writer committed to the table in this run.

completed_at.description: When the writer finished with the table: the end of the write window, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset.

started_at.description: When the writer's first commit to the table began, ISO-8601 UTC.

writer.description: The producer and its version, e.g. "target-iceberg/0.3.0".

full_refresh.description: True when the table's contents were replaced wholesale.

rows.description: Rows the writer committed to the table in this run.

bytes_added.description: Bytes of data files the run added.

partitions_changed.description: Partitions the run changed. Omitted rather than estimated when not exact: summing per-snapshot counts over-counts.

snapshot_count.description: Snapshots the run committed to the table.

streams.description: The source streams that wrote the table.

table_uuid.description: The table's `table-uuid` from its metadata (required from format v2). Informational: tells a consumer the table was recreated since the write.

warehouse_id.description: The catalog's own identifier for the warehouse, where it has one. Informational only: not part of the Iceberg REST specification.

catalog_uri.description: The catalog URI as the writer reached it. Informational only: the same catalog is reached by different URLs from different places.
